entity.name: Guy Steiff
entity.description: Maintainer of SponsorCut, a local Android media-processing application.

projects.name: SponsorCut
projects.description: SponsorCut processes media files locally. It supports processing without segmentation, local TXT/JSON segment imports, manual segment creation and editing, and offline use of locally stored segment sets. Optional external database lookup may provide segmentation data, but is not required.
